name: shopify-checkout-functions
description: A suite of Shopify cart transform functions
summary: Handles special checkout rules for the Shopify store by managing free items, bundle pricing, shipping restrictions based on destination, and limiting member reward discount codes to one per order. Store admins use it to prevent incorrect free items in carts, ensure bundles are properly priced, restrict shipping options depending on location, and avoid stacking multiple member discounts. This keeps the checkout process smooth, fair, and compliant with store policies without manual oversight.
